issues.description: Math_unary registration is outside the class block due to missing blank line, breaking the decorator chain
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` is indented at module level immediately after the class body, deleting the blank line that previously separated `Math_unary` from `@infer_global(math.atan2)`. The diff also shows the `Math_unary` class trailing whitespace was removed. Reads as sloppy; respect the surrounding file's blocking with two blank lines between top-level defs.

Both `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` gain `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guards but the diff shows no `import sys` added to either file. If `sys` isn't already imported at the top, this is a straight NameError at import time on every Python version. Did the author actually run this? Show me the build.

issues.description: Version-gate style is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase
issues.detail: The test file uses `from numba.core.utils import PYVERSION` and `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)`. The two impl files and mathdecl.py use a freshly-imported `sys.version_info`. Pick one. The codebase already has `PYVERSION` for exactly this; use it everywhere or explain why not.

issues.description: Release note file is missing a trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. Trivial to fix and every reviewer is going to flag it. Fix it before resubmit so we're not having this conversation.

issues.description: Test x_values don't actually exercise exp2's distinguishing behavior
issues.detail: Copy-pasted from `test_exp` verbatim, including the duplicated `-2` and the same fractional points. exp2 is the base-2 exponential; at minimum include an integer like 10 where the expected value (1024) is obvious, and a negative half-integer. Right now the test proves the LLVM intrinsic is wired up, not that it's the right intrinsic.

issues.description: Release note title underline length is fragile
issues.detail: RST underlines must be at least as long as the title. `Add support for ``math.exp2``.` is 31 chars; the underline is 30 dashes. Depending on how RST counts the backticks this may render or warn. Make the underline longer than the title, always.

review.summary: First-contributor patch; the shape is right (decl + two impls + test + docs + release note) but it would not land as-is. The biggest problem is that two of the three impl files reference `sys.version_info` without showing an `import sys` — that's a NameError waiting to happen and suggests the patch wasn't built and run on a clean checkout. The decoration of `Math_unary` for `math.exp2` is jammed into the class block's whitespace in a way that's hard to read and inconsistent with the file's voice. Version-gating uses two different idioms across four files; pick `PYVERSION` and stick with it. Tests are a copy-paste of `test_exp` and don't actually validate base-2 semantics. NEEDS-WORK — fix the import, normalize the version check, give exp2 its own test values, and resubmit.
